I am a young woman farming this small plot of beans in Zomba. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I will not buy expensive chemical fertilizer that I cannot afford anyway. I will apply manure from our livestock because it helps the soil and costs nothing. I will use local bean seeds saved from last season since improved seed is too costly for such a small plot, and I will not spray any chemicals or irrigate because we depend entirely on the rains. My family will work about 20 days on this plot from planting to harvest, and I will not hire any outside labor because we do not have money for wages.
